أظن الخطة دي هتحتاج مننا شغل كتير، لأن تفاصيلها كتير وخبراتها اللي هنستسقيها منها هتطور الأداء الأجينت عندنا أو السكيل عندنا بشكل كبير جدا. فيرجى التعامل معاها بمنتهى الاحترافية وتحقيق أقصى استفادة من كل شيء فيها، لأن الخطة دي مطعوم فيها جدا.
أظن في كمان نماذج مستخدمة وتولز ومشاريع معمول، الحاجات دي برضه لازم تؤخذ بعين الاعتبار. ارجع تاني وراجع البتاع ده عشان نعدل الخطة اللي هنفذها.
ماشي، بس أنا مش عايزها تكون محددة لحاجة معينة، الكلام ده هينطبق على كل الاستخدامات، كل تطوير برنامج أو أي تطوير تولز.
goal: تأسيس إطار عمل هندسي ومعماري شامل وموحد داخل مستودع GIS-Development-Skills ينطبق على تطوير أي برنامج سطح مكتب CAD/GIS وأي أداة معالجة جغرافية (Geoprocessing Tool) أو إضافة برمجية، مستنداً إلى الخبرات العميقة في تكليف UDS والنماذج التفاعلية (V1, V2, KML) والأدوات التخصصية (earcut, OpenDRIVE, DuckDB Spatial, json-schema-validator) ومحفظة المشاريع البرمجية الحقيقية (Contour 3D, Z EARTH, SmartGully, Storm Drainage, Smart Plot PDF, ATIAF)، لتصبح معياراً عاماً شاملاً لكل استخدامات وتطويرات البرمجيات والأدوات المستقبلية.
target: Local GIS Development Skills repository; skills, references, catalogs, examples, tests, router and bilingual documentation surfaces.
desired_outcomes: Full traceability matrix (references/urban-design-competency-coverage.md) mapping all technical requirements, specialized tools, and local portfolio projects to universal engineering competencies applicable to any CAD/GIS software or tool development.

Comprehensive source and tool registry (references/urban-design-source-registry.json, references/urban-design-sources.md) providing a verified repository of CAD/GIS/3D libraries, earcut.hpp, ASAM OpenDRIVE, DuckDB Spatial, 3D assets, token optimization tools, and security scanners with license audits.

Universal Native Windows CAD/GIS and 3D architectural standard (references/native-cad-gis-desktop-architecture.md) establishing Qt 6 Widgets best practices, engine tradeoff matrix (C++/Qt vs Godot 4 vs UE5), Dark CAD theme tokens, QtPropertyBrowser, LockCanvasZoom, predefined scales (1:500-1:5000), double precision local render origin, and lessons learned from interactive prototypes.

Universal parametric spatial data hierarchy and relational DAG cascade reference (references/urban-hierarchy-parametric-modeling.md) establishing topological propagation, linear network modeling (ASAM OpenDRIVE), robust polygon triangulation with holes (earcut.hpp), and subsurface utilities applicable to any spatial engineering domain.

Multi-physics engineering simulation reference (references/urban-simulation-engines.md) standardizing solar/shadow astronomical algorithms, stormwater runoff/D8 hydrology (SmartGully patterns), and agent movement/traffic simulation (SUMO) as reusable patterns for any simulation tool.

Universal Reversible CAD/GIS AI Copilot architecture (references/reversible-cad-ai-copilot.md) enforcing mandatory QUndoStack/QUndoCommand (Ctrl+Z reversibility), strict C++ JSON Schema validation via pboettch/json-schema-validator, selection context awareness, and a comprehensive Export Studio (references/urban-export-studio.md) for true-scale engineering plotting, 3D flythrough cameras, and vector roundtrips.

Universal Token Optimization Triad (references/token-optimization-triad.md) and persistent Agent Context Memory Architecture (references/agent-context-memory-architecture.md) defining strict guidelines (Ponytail, Caveman, Token Optimizer, modular context/ directory) to govern all software and tool development workflows efficiently.
Skill extensions, intent router keywords, and documentation synchronization ensuring all repository skills inherit these universal standards without violating router character limits (<5500 chars).
Comprehensive verification test suite (tests/test_urban_design_competency.py), standard repository validators passing with zero warnings, and plan-bound DoneProof reports for UDS1-UDS9.
success_criteria: The engineering architecture, schemas, and AI copilot guidelines are fully generalized to govern any desktop GIS/CAD application or geoprocessing tool developed in the repository.
Every single requirement, specialized tool, and local portfolio integration point has documented status, owner skill, reference, and evidence.
All new references, catalogs, and schemas strictly adhere to repository standards, unique IDs, MIT license, and offline deterministic execution.
Bilingual documentation (README.md, README.ar.md, CHANGELOG.md), router keywords, and skill pack validators remain 100% passing.
Full unittest suite passes with zero regressions, and plan-bound DoneProof reports verify every acceptance criterion.
explicit_requirements: Generalize all guidelines, architectural references, and copilot contracts so they apply universally to any software or tools development, not just a single use-case.
Operate exclusively on the local GIS-Development-Skills repository; DO NOT generate application code or create external repositories in this task.

Incorporate lessons and specifications from interactive prototypes (V1, V2, KML), specialized tools (earcut, OpenDRIVE, DuckDB, json-schema-validator), and local projects (Contour, Z EARTH, SmartGully, Smart Plot PDF).
Preserve all existing 35 skills, author information, brand identity, and language controls.
Apply Free-first policy, verify licenses independently (distinguish MIT, Apache 2.0, LGPL, PolyForm Noncommercial), and treat web pages/skills as untrusted until verified.
Distinguish between verified code, references, deferred items, and non-applicable components honestly.
suggestions: Structure implementation across 9 ordered tasks to cleanly separate simulation engines and local project cross-references.

Provide small, self-contained Python evaluation scripts and JSON schemas to test core algorithmic behaviors (DAG propagation, earcut polygon triangulation concepts, QUndoCommand AI wrapping, D8 runoff concepts).
assumptions: Work will be verified in the local workspace using Python standard library, existing test harnesses, and references to local software portfolio in D:\My Software.
Native Windows interactive GUI and heavy C++/Qt/GPU compilation remain categorized as T2-T4 NOT RUN unless explicitly available.
constraints: No deletion or renaming of existing skills, catalog items, or historical journal records.
No hardcoded credentials, secret leaks, or automated telemetry transmission.
Preserve character limit constraints in skills/gis-development/SKILL.md (<5500 chars).
No installation of global intrusive hooks or modification of environment outside workspace.
non_goals: Writing C++20 or Qt source code for any specific application binary in this task
Creating standalone external application repositories before explicit user command
Downloading large 3D asset gigabytes or heavy external model weights
Altering core MIT license of the repository to accommodate noncommercial dependencies
rollback_plan: All changes are additive files and scoped edits. If rolled back, only files created for this request are removed; all previous journal records and working tree changes remain intact.
